handoff.done:
**IH-2 — ledgercheck run-ledger schema gate** (commit 0fb5298, pushed, CI-verified green: run 27720305663 conclusion=success on sha 0fb5298).
The class closed: the run ledger (.socom/ledger/runs.jsonl) — the #6f measurement spine `socom cycle` rolls into pass@1/pass@k — was validated by NOTHING. xmlcheck is XML-only; `socom cycle` only caught JSON-decode errors. A row that was valid JSON yet schema-invalid (missing `verdict`, `gate_band:"purple"`) sailed through every gate and silently mis-scored the eval gate. The substrate was failing its own residuality gate on its own measurement surface.
The fix: new tests/ledgercheck.py validates every ledger row against schemas/ledger.xml (8 required keys + 2 enums gate_band/verdict + 3 int-typed fields, bool excluded). The field contract is PARSED FROM schemas/ledger.xml — single source, no hardcoded list (a hardcoded copy would relocate the drift stress, not remove it; §least-common-mechanism / open-design). Posture split by concern: absent ledger PASSES (fail-open on absence — created lazily, zero rows = zero bad rows), malformed/invalid row FAILS (fail-closed on corruption). SCHEMA resolves script-relative (found from any CWD); LEDGER resolves CWD-relative like xmlcheck (medium/full from repo root hit the real ledger) with an optional path arg the smoke harness uses for fixtures.
Wired into checks.medium + checks.full + all 3 CI adapters (github / gitlab / azure) via `socom compile` — NOT by hand. +5 smoke checks (10d-bis block). Independent reviewer from clean context (builder != reviewer): VERDICT ACCEPT, 8/8 contract checks + adversarial probes clean (real _ledger_row kept/broken rows PASS; blank lines, non-object JSON, omitted optional `contract`, foreign CWD all handled). Reviewer advisory (bool-is-int) closed in-session. Evidence: full chain green — smoke.sh then xmlcheck.py then ledgercheck.py then `socom index` then echo full-ok -> exit 0 (the checks.full binding); pre-commit + pre-push gates PASS; 130+ smoke checks green; CI run 27720305663 conclusion=success.

handoff.warnings: - The feared full-check duplication across CI adapters does NOT exist: all three (github/gitlab/azure) are generated from socom.yaml's checks.full via `socom compile` — single-sourced. Edit socom.yaml + recompile; never the adapters by hand. - .socom/index/chunks.jsonl churns on any `socom index` (pre-push full + the compile step). It did NOT churn on this push, but the posture is still undecided — IH-4 owns it. Do not hand-edit it. - .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl still does not exist (created lazily on first `verify --record` or `gate task-completion`). ledgercheck PASSES on absence by design — but the moment any agent records a row, ledgercheck is live and a malformed row will RED medium/full/CI. That is the intended behaviour. - CI carries the known Node-20 -> Node-24 forced-runtime deprecation annotation (maintenance debt, commit b28ada4). Still green; bump actions/checkout + actions/setup-python versions at the canon root soon.
